01 · ABOUT THE EVENT

A movement celebrating the power of women.

Kranti Jyoti Women’s Run 2027 is a landmark initiative celebrating the strength, courage, unity and determination of women.

Inspired by the revolutionary legacy of Krantijyoti Savitribai Phule, this movement brings women together to promote fitness, equality, confidence and empowerment.

With 22,000+ women expected, every step represents a story, every stride reflects determination, and every participant becomes a symbol of strength and inspiration.

Run for Strength. Run for Equality. Run for Empowerment.

02 · THE INSPIRATION

Inspired by Krantijyoti Savitribai Phule.

Savitribai Phule was a pioneering educator and social reformer who transformed women’s education and social equality in India. Her courage and vision continue to inspire generations.

This run celebrates her legacy and the spirit of every woman who dares to dream, challenges limitations and moves forward with confidence.
